description_en: Queries the details of O&M events
description_zh: 调用DescribeMaintenanceAction接口查询运维事件的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-maintenance-action --biz-region cn-hangzhou --task-type rds_apsaradb_upgrade --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMaintenanceAction

parameters.help_en:
The region. Valid values:
The region ID of the region where the O&M event occurs, such as `cn-hangzhou`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs.
You can also enter `all` to view all O&M events in all regions under the current account. When `Region` is set to `all`, `TaskType` must also be set to `all`
parameters.help_zh:
地域。取值如下：
运维事件所在地域的地域ID，如`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID。
您也可以输入`all`查看当前账号下所有地域下的所有运维事件，当`Region`设置为`all`时，`TaskType`也必须设置为`all`
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O&M event. Valid values:
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: database software upgrade
all: all O&M events in all regions under the current account. When `Region` is set to `all`, `TaskType` must also be set to `all`
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件的类型，取值如下：
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：数据库软件升级。
all：查看当前账号下所有地域下的所有运维事件，当`Region`设置为`all`时，`TaskType`也必须设置为`all`
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the details of pending or historical O&M events. Valid values:
0: returns the details of pending O&M events
1: returns the details of historical O&M events

If this parameter is left empty, the details of pending O&M events are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回待处理或历史运维事件的详情，取值如下：
0：返回待处理运维事件的详情。
1：返回历史运维事件的详情。

若该参数留空，默认返回待处理运维事件的详情
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 (default), 50, and 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值为30（默认值）、50或100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the region where the O&M event occurs.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件所在地域的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time of the O&M event. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 运维事件的创建时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster involved in the O&M event
DBClusterId.description_zh: 运维事件所涉及集群的集群ID

DBType.description_en: The engine type of the database

Deadline.description_en: The latest time within the adjustable range for the execution time of the O&M event. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
Deadline.description_zh: 运维事件执行时间可调整范围的最晚时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

Id.description_en: The ID of the O&M event

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the switchover time of the O&M event is modified. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改运维事件切换时间的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time required before the switchover of the O&M event. The time is in the `HH:mm:ss` format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 运维事件切换之前所需的准备时间，格式为`HH:mm:ss`

Region.description_en: The region ID of the region where the O&M event occurs
Region.description_zh: 运维事件所在地域的地域ID

ResultInfo.description_en:
The execution result of the O&M event.
This parameter is returned only when the value of `Status` is FAILED (the event is completed but the execution failed) or CANCEL (the event is canceled)
ResultInfo.description_zh:
运维事件的执行结果。
仅当`Status`（状态）取值为FAILED（运维事件结束但执行失败）或CANCEL（事件已取消）时，返回该参数

StartTime.description_en: The time when the O&M event is executed in the background. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行该运维事件的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The status of the event.
If you set `IsHistory` to 0, the status details of pending O&M events are returned. Valid values:
    - WAITING_MODIFY: waiting for the user to set the start time of the O&M event
    - WAITING: the O&M event is waiting to be processed
    - PROCESSING: the O&M event is being processed (you cannot modify the switchover time of an event in this state)
If you set `IsHistory` to 1, the status details of historical O&M events are returned. Valid values:
     - SUCCESS: the event is completed and executed successfully
     - FAILED: the event is completed but the execution failed
     - CANCEL: the event is canceled
Status.description_zh:
事件状态。
若您设置`IsHistory`为0，则返回待处理运维事件状态的详情，取值范围如下：
    - WAITING_MODIFY：等待用户设置运维事件开始时间。
    - WAITING：运维事件正在等待处理。
    - PROCESSING：运维事件正在处理中（不支持修改处于该状态下事件的切换时间）。
若您设置`IsHistory`为1，则返回历史运维事件状态的详情，取值范围如下：
     - SUCCESS：事件结束且执行成功。
     - FAILED：事件结束但执行失败。
     - CANCEL：事件已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The expected switchover time of the O&M event. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
SwitchTime.description_zh: 运维事件预计的切换时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

TaskType.description_en: The type of the O&M event

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
